---
title: "Float Point Numbers"
---


```{r}
# numbers with exact binary representation
print(.0, digits = 22)
print(.5, digits = 22)
print(.25, digits = 22)
print(.75, digits = 22)
print(.125, digits = 22)
print(.625, digits = 22)
print(.375, digits = 22)
print(.875, digits = 22)
```
```{r}
# numbers without exact binary representation
print(.1, digits = 22)
print(.6, digits = 22)
print(.26, digits = 22)
print(.76, digits = 22)
print(.126, digits = 22)
print(.626, digits = 22)
print(.376, digits = 22)
print(.876, digits = 22)
```

```{r}
(.1 + .1 + .1) == .3
```


```{r}
print(.1 + .1 + .1, digits = 22)
print(.3, digits = 22)
```

```{r}
dplyr::near(.1 + .1 + .1, .3)
```
